en.t: Every night, the west wind was always blowing.

units.source_text: 但是对局的十二月一日早晨，天气晴朗，到处充满阳光。

en.t: But on the morning of December 1, the day of the match, the weather was clear and sunlight filled everything around them.

units.source_text: 昨日白天，名人下过将棋之后，到镇上打台球去了。

en.t: During the day yesterday, after playing shogi, the Master went into town to play billiards.

units.source_text: 晚上他同岩本六段、村岛五段、八幡干事搓麻将，直到十一点才罢。

en.t: In the evening he played mahjong with Iwamoto Sixth Dan, Murashima Fifth Dan, and Secretary Yahata, and they did not stop until eleven o'clock.

units.source_text: 今早不到八点便起床，到庭院里散步。

en.t: This morning he got up before eight and went for a walk in the garden.

units.source_text: 庭院里，落了一只红蜻蜓。

en.t: In the garden, a red dragonfly had settled.
